note: Declarative cross-type relationship overlay for the brain. The logic edges (maps-to / gates / supersedes / relates) are NOT derivable from the structured sources — they live in domain knowledge, so they are DECLARED here, never inferred or invented. Seeded with the unambiguous golden-record <- catalog-field consolidations (same real-world entity, different vocabulary). Extend with team-confirmed relationships: gates (OpenQuestion -> Decision/Deliverable it blocks), supersedes (Decision -> Decision it revises). scripts/gen-brain.py emits these as edges; any edge whose endpoint is not a real node is dropped by the compiler.
